lines: Beyond the Ditch lie the Scarlands. Other adventurers can attack you there, and you them.
At Scarlands level 1 you can fight adventurers within 1 combat level of you (41 to 43); every 8 steps north widens the range by one.
If you fall there you keep only your 3 most valuable items; the rest goes to whoever dealt you the most damage.
Attacking an adventurer who did not attack you first puts a skull over your head for 20 minutes: a skulled adventurer keeps nothing (only Keepsake Ward saves one thing).
Above level 20 no ordinary teleport will carry you out, and you cannot leave the world within 10 seconds of a fight.
You would keep: Bronze greatsword, Bronze warhammer, Apprentice staff.
